title: Lesson 1 Quiz: Layer 2s, Interoperability, and Real-World Assets

questions.text: What is a primary benefit of using a Layer 2 solution such as Optimism or Arbitrum?
options: They increase transaction fees by processing each transaction individually.
They reduce cost per transaction by batching many transactions before settling on the mainnet.
They eliminate the need for any blockchain security.
They allow users to bypass all regulatory requirements.
questions.explanation: Layer 2 solutions batch many transactions off‑chain and settle them on Ethereum, lowering the cost per transaction.

questions.text: True or false: Cross‑chain bridges enable interoperability by locking a token on the source chain and minting a representation on the destination chain.
questions.explanation: Bridges lock tokens on the source chain and mint a representative token on the destination chain to enable cross‑chain movement.
